claim: Royal Albert Dock is a free open-air heritage waterfront in Liverpool, the most-visited free attraction in North West England, with bars, restaurants and museums clustered around the historic basin.
quote: Royal Albert Dock Liverpool is the most-visited free tourist destination in North West England

claim: Tate Liverpool's Albert Dock building is closed for redevelopment; the gallery is operating from a temporary home at RIBA North, Mann Island, free entry, open 10:00-17:50.
quote: Tate Liverpool is currently open at RIBA North, Mann Island (10.00-17.50), while their Royal Albert Dock home is temporarily closed for redevelopment.

claim: National Museums Liverpool venues (Museum of Liverpool, Walker Art Gallery, World Museum) are open Tuesday-Sunday 10:00-17:00 with free admission.
quote: Our museums and galleries are open from 10am-5pm, Tuesday to Sunday

claim: Both the International Slavery Museum and Merseyside Maritime Museum closed in January 2025 for redevelopment and are due to reopen in 2028 — not available for a 2026 visit.
quote: Both museums are due to reopen in 2028

claim: The Beatles Story at Royal Albert Dock opens Saturday 09:00-18:30 (last entry 17:15), Sun-Fri 09:00-17:30.
quote: Sunday – Friday: 9am – 5:30pm (last entry 4:15pm) and Saturday: 9am – 6:30pm (last entry 5:15pm)

claim: Beatles Story admission is £20 adult, £16 concession, £11 child (5-15), under-5s free; ticket includes multilingual audio guide.
The Cavern Club on Mathew Street is open 11:00-02:00 Friday & Saturday with single entry £6 or all-day pass £8.50, cashless only.
quote: Adults (18+) single entry: £6 (Pay on the door); All Day & Night pass: £8.50

claim: Liverpool Cathedral (Anglican) is open Saturday 10:00-18:00 with the Tower Experience available 10:00-16:30 last entry; building entry is free.
quote: Saturdays the Cathedral is open 10:00am-18:00pm with the Tower available 10:00am-16:30pm

claim: The Metropolitan Cathedral of Christ the King is open daily 07:30-18:00 with free admission; Lutyens Crypt is open Mon-Sat 10:00-16:00 (last entry 15:30).
quote: Open Monday to Sunday 7.30am to 6.00pm. Crypt open Monday to Saturday from 10am to 4pm (last visit at 3.30pm)

claim: The British Music Experience in the Cunard Building (Pier Head) is open Wed-Sun 10:00-17:00 (last entry 15:45); admission £21 walk-up / £19 pre-booked online for adults.
quote: Wednesday to Sunday from 10am to 5pm, with last admission at 3:45pm. General admission is £21 (£19 if pre-booked online)

claim: Liverpool ONE shopping district opens 09:00-19:00 on Saturdays; the on-site car parks total around 3,000 spaces with tariffs from ~£3.30/hour and £22/24hr, with a 15% discount via the LIVONE promo code.
quote: Saturday: 9 am to 7 pm... around 3,000 car parking spaces. Parking starts at around £3.30 for 1 hour, £11 for 5 hours, and £22 for 24 hours

claim: Mersey Ferries' 50-minute River Explorer Cruise from Pier Head runs hourly on Saturdays with the last boat departing Seacombe at 16:00 (Liverpool side ~20 past the hour).
quote: On Saturdays and Sundays, the last boat departs at 16:00, hourly from Seacombe with departures at 20 minutes past the hour

claim: Driving from Aughton to central Liverpool covers about 10 miles and takes roughly 19 minutes in typical traffic via the A59/M58.
quote: The driving distance between Aughton to Liverpool is 10 miles... approximately 19 min to drive

claim: Town Green station is on the Merseyrail Northern Line with direct services to Liverpool Central via Ormskirk branch trains.
quote: Town-green train station | timetable | ticket prices & facilities | Merseyrail

claim: Trains from Aughton Park / Town Green to Liverpool Central run roughly every 15 minutes on the Merseyrail Ormskirk-Liverpool branch with a journey time around 30-35 minutes; advance fares from ~£8.79.
quote: Trains Aughton Park to Liverpool from $10.79
